title: Where to keep your emergency fund
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: An emergency fund must be safe and quickly available, not high-return. Good homes for it: a savings account or sweep-in FD for the first one month of expenses (instant access), and a liquid fund or short FD for the rest (usually available within a day). Do not park it in stocks, equity funds, crypto or lock-in schemes like PPF, because you may need it exactly when markets are down. Keep it separate from your spending account so you do not dip into it. Build it in steps: first one month of expenses, then three, then six months (more if your income is irregular or you support family). After you use it, refill it before you restart investing.
summary_hinglish: Emergency fund safe aur turant milne wala hona chahiye. Pehle mahine ka kharcha savings account ya sweep FD mein, baaki liquid fund ya chhoti FD mein. Stocks, crypto ya PPF jaisi lock-in cheezon mein mat rakho. Pehle 1 mahina, phir 3, phir 6 mahine ka target.
summary_hi: आपातकालीन फंड सुरक्षित और तुरंत उपलब्ध होना चाहिए। पहले एक महीने का खर्च बचत खाते या स्वीप FD में, बाकी लिक्विड फंड या छोटी FD में। इसे शेयर, क्रिप्टो या PPF जैसी लॉक-इन चीज़ों में न रखें। पहले 1 महीना, फिर 3, फिर 6 महीने का लक्ष्य रखें।
